articleTitle: Inception Spatial Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks for Skeleton-Based Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: Graph convolutional networks is widely used in the field of skeleton-based motion recognition because of its characteristics of applying to non-Euclidean data. But most of the existing methods based on graph convolutional networks only perform convolution between adjacent joint points, ignoring the connection with farther joint points and symmetrical points. In order to improve the accuracy of skeleton-based action recognition, we propose a novel Inception spatial temporal graph convolutional networks (IST-GCN) for skeleton-based action recognition. By introducing the symmetry characteristics of the skeleton, our model can extract the interactive features of the symmetrical part of the human body. We also use the idea of multi-scale convolution to improve graph convolutional networks and temporal convolutional networks based on the Inception structure to better extract spatial and temporal features. A large number of experiments on NTU-RGB+D dataset show that our models have achieved higher accuracy and are more suitable for application in skeleton-based motion recognition. Codes are available at https://github.com/julycrow/IST-GCN.

articleTitle: An Improved Bearing Defect Detection Algorithm Based on Yolo
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: Bearings are essential and have been widely used in mechanical equipment. However, surface defects on bearings can seriously affect their performance and service life, and manual inspection requires high labor costs. Automatic visual inspection approaches for bearing defect detection become important to ensure equipment safety. Given the difficulty of different forms of defects on bearing surfaces, we propose to obtain defect images with multi-angle lights and to detect defects based on an object detection algorithm with several variations as follows. We eliminate data imbalance by using a focal loss function. We improve network nonlinearity by using a smooth activation function. Experimental results show that the proposed surface defect detection algorithm can achieve an accuracy of 97.56%, much better than traditional approaches. Ablation experiments verify the effectiveness of our variations.

articleTitle: Research on bearing oil film condition monitoring based on acoustic emission parameters
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: The quality of bearing lubrication state is directly related to the working performance and service life of the equipment. It is very important to monitor and judge the state of bearing lubricating oil film in time. Based on acoustic emission (AE) technology, this paper studies the propagation characteristics of AE signal in variable volume multi-layer plate, and puts forward Variation parameters to characterize the influence of oil film on signal propagation. The results show that the proposed parameters have an effect on the models under different plate volume combinations, and can judge whether there is oil film or not. In this paper, the three-dimensional bearing model is used for verification, which is very consistent with the flat plate results. The work of this paper lays a foundation for monitoring the state of bearing oil film lubrication by AE technology.

articleTitle: The Analysis of EEG Signals in Driving Behavior Based on Nonlinear Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: When the driver is driving the vehicle, there are three driving behaviors. They are turning left, turning right, and going straight. In order to find out the difference of different driving behaviors on electroencephalogram (EEG) signals, an experimental method was designed to collect the EEG signals from different driving behaviors of drivers. The EEG signals were analyzed and studied by nonlinear dynamics. Firstly, the EEG signals were sub-band decomposed by wavelet transform to extract the alpha wave and the artifacts of the signals were removed. Then, the processed EEG signals from different driving behaviors were calculated to get the complexity and approximate entropy by the Lempel-Ziv complexity algorithm and the approximate entropy algorithm in nonlinear dynamics. The calculation results showed that the complexity value and approximate entropy of the EEG signal from turning left were the largest, and the complexity and approximate entropy of the EEG signal from going straight were the smallest. The result indicated that among the three driving behaviors, the EEG signals of drivers from turning left was relatively more complex and the most random. However, the change rate of the EEG signal complexity and approximate entropy in the three driving behaviors was not large, and the difference was not significant.

articleTitle: Trajectory Planning of Deep-Sea Hydraulic Manipulator in Joint Space with Flow Constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: For the grasping task of the deep-sea hydraulic manipulator, it is necessary to carry out kinematic analysis and point-to-point joint motion planning. To reduce the influence of the structural error of the manipulator caused by manufacturing, assembly, transportation, environment, and other factors on the kinematics parameters of the manipulator, RBF neural network is used to identify the kinematics model parameters of the manipulator to obtain more accurate modified D-H parameters. Based on this model and flow constraints, the PSO algorithm is used to plan the joint space trajectory of the deep-sea hydraulic manipulator. The experimental results show that the method can well meet the needs of joint-space planning of the deep-sea hydraulic manipulator that is subjected to flow constraints and lay a foundation for subsequent complex tasks.

articleTitle: Point cloud registration method based on 3DMatch network and improved ISS algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: Point cloud registration is a key technology in the fields of SLAM and 3D reconstruction. Aiming at the problem of the high initial position of the point cloud by the traditional ICP algorithm, and the problems of inconspicuous feature and low matching rate caused by the use of random sampling strategy in the classic 3D Match point cloud registration algorithm, the improved ISS key point extraction algorithm is used to obtain key points. And input the 3D Match network to obtain the 512-dimensional feature vector, RANSAC was used to eliminate mismatches, and then rigid body transformation matrix was calculated by SVD to complete coarse registration of point cloud. Then use the ICP algorithm to perform the fine registration of the point cloud. The final experimental results show that the algorithm has excellent performance and can complete the point cloud registration quickly and accurately.

articleTitle: Synchronization analysis for Asynchronous k-valued logical Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: In this paper, the synchronization problems of k-valued logical networks are investigated under asynchronous update strategy. First, we study the inner synchronization of asynchronous k-valued logical networks, then, based on the algebraic representations of asynchronous k-valued logical networks with the semi-tenor product of matrices, establish a necessary and sufficient criterion on the inner synchronization of asynchronous k-valued logical networks. Next, we investigate the outer synchronization between a driving asynchronous k-valued logical network and a corresponding response k-valued logical network, and give a theorem for outer synchronization of asynchronous k-valued logical networks. Finally, two illustrative examples are provided to verify the efficiency of the proposed results.

articleTitle: Research on Talent Classification Based on Improved KNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: With the rapid increase in the scale of colleges and universities, it is necessary to effectively classify the comprehensive quality of students, conduct stratified teaching for students, and apply KNN to the talent training in colleges and universities to provide support for the classified teaching of talent training in colleges and universities. However, the sample distribution of KNN algorithm is uneven or the sample size is too large, which affects the accuracy and efficiency of the algorithm. To solve this problem, the KNN algorithm is improved, the rough set upper and lower approximation concept is introduced to define the upper and lower approximation space of samples, and the KNN adaptive weighted classification decision function is proposed to improve the classification accuracy and efficiency. Experiments show that this method not only ensures the classification accuracy, but also improves the classification efficiency.

articleTitle: High Precision Servo Control of Single-phase BLDC motor based on Fuzzy self-tuning PID
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: A high-precision servo control scheme based on fuzzy self-tuning PID is proposed to address the increased motor vibration and torque ripple caused by the asymmetric air gap structure of single-phase brushless DC motors. First, the mathematical model and state equations of the single-phase brushless DC motor are derived. Then, a simulation model of fuzzy self-tuning PID is designed and excellent step response curves are obtained by running simulation. Next, based on the established physical platform, the servo position accuracy of conventional PID and fuzzy self-tuning PID are compared and analyzed. Finally, the method is successfully applied to a fuel valve of gas metering system, which shows that the proposed method improves the servo positioning accuracy of the single-phase brushless DC motor and has certain market application value.

articleTitle: Real-time research based on ARM-based robot EtherCAT master system
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: In order to solve the real-time problem in the motion control system of industrial robot based on arm, this paper adopts EtherCAT real-time industrial Ethernet, analyzes the key points to improve the real-time performance, establishes the system framework to meet the openness of the motion controller system of industrial robot, designs the Pruss real-time core and real-time drive module, and builds the test platform, Finally, the jitter of communication cycle is less than 1US, which fully meets the real-time requirements of industrial robot motion control system.

articleTitle: End-to-end autonomous driving based on image plane waypoint prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: Mainstream autonomous driving algorithms rely on high-definition (HD) maps, but HD maps are time-consuming and involve tedious manual labor. Some studies have adopted a simple end-to-end approach for autonomous driving, where inputed sensor informations are directly mapped to vehicle control quantities. This approach does not rely on HD maps, but is closely related to vehicle dynamics and is difficult to transfer directly between different vehicles, while being less capable of interpretation and generalization. To address the above issues, this paper proposed an end-to-end autonomous driving algorithm based on image-plane waypoints prediction, where the waypoints is an intermediate state quantity from input end to control end. Our method does not rely on HD maps, but also has good interpretability and generalization.

articleTitle: Wireless charging tuning strategy for electric vehicles based on gravitational search algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: The wireless charging technology for electric vehicles transmits electrical energy in the form of a high frequency alternating magnetic field from a transmitter buried underground to a receiving end of the vehicle within a certain range on the ground, which in turn supplies power to the on-board energy storage equipment. This paper presents strategies for calculating and improving the charging efficiency and also the effective distance for wireless charging of electric vehicles according to the way they are charged. Firstly, the transmit and receive circuit topology is analyzed and simplified to obtain a decoupled equivalent circuit, based on which a Neumann formula-based model of radio energy transmission efficiency is developed. The integral relationship between the mutual inductance of the coil and the spacing between the two coaxial coils is obtained using Neumann's formula. This paper improves the efficiency of power transmission by changing the resistance value of the onboard receiver circuit. This paper uses a gravitational search algorithm to improve the transmitter circuit to obtain maximum power transfer efficiency and obtains an optimal electric vehicle wireless charging topology adjustment strategy with fast calculation and high accuracy.

articleTitle: Intention Recognition Based on Multi-layer Attention and Label Embedding
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: Realizing the intention according to the questions raised by user is one of key issues in dialogue Systems. To address the issue of the accuracy of user intent recognition, this paper proposes the Label Embedding Hierarchical Attention Networks (LE _HAN) algorithm with reference to the multi-layer Attention model and the introduction of prior knowledge in semantic extraction. The method first uses word granularity to embed the text vector. Then the semantic context information is extracted by bidirectional GRU and the important information in hidden state is extracted by Self_attention. Thirdly, fuse the information using bidirectional GRU and map the label information to the same vector space of the GRU hidden state as the query vector. Fourthly, the query vector is computed with the GRU hidden state as the attention vector. Finally, the query vector and the GRU hidden state are computed by attention calculation to complete the fusion of sentence semantics and label information. The results of the comparison experiments show that the algorithm achieves a high accuracy rate on the selected Chinese experimental dataset and has certain advantages over other algorithms.

articleTitle: A distributed ship tracking algorithm based on particle filter
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: Accurate ship tracking is one of the important means to implement accurate ship monitoring and reduce traffic accidents. The traditional ship tracking is based on the single sensor source such as VTS, AIS or CCTV to realize the data processing. The accuracy of single data source is not high, and it is difficult to meet the requirements of water transportation management. In order to improve the accuracy of ship tracking, a distributed ship tracking algorithm based on particle filter is proposed, and it integrates AIS and CCTV data. At the edge of CCTV, YOLO technology is used to identify ships and the identified status information is returned to the cloud. by the distributed parallel particle filter, the cloud realizes the prediction of ship state from AIS data, and the correction of ship state from CCTV data. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can track the ship state more effective and accurate than the traditional ship tracking algorithm.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Intelligent Community Based on Naive Bayes
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: Community service has become an indispensable source of service in people's life, but the traditional way of service can't meet people's fast pace of life. Therefore, smart community (smart city) appears in people's vision, which can greatly improve the quality of our life and reduce the inconvenient factors that life may bring. The smart community designed and studied in this paper is divided into five functional modules: user login and registration function, function selection, personnel management, vehicle management, health management module. Among them, the login function, function selection, personnel management module is to interact with the database, to achieve the transmission of information. The health management module is based on the naive Bayes algorithm to classify the safety level of COVID-19, a currently popular influenza virus, to realize the health monitoring of community personnel and prevent the continuous spread of Novel Coronavirus. The intelligent community can ensure the integrity of data and information, simple operation, perfect function and superior performance. At the same time, the intelligent community combined with the naive Bayes algorithm for health management design, embodies the development principle of intelligent community, people-oriented.

articleTitle: A Study on Improving Passenger Ride Comfort
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: In this paper, on the basis of studying the development and application of the ride sense active control technology of mainstream civil aircraft, the differential pressure signal formed by different pressure fields on both sides of the vertical tail is used in the ride-sense control of a large passenger civil aircraft. According to the ride quality requirements of the civil aircraft, from the perspective of the physical realization of the system and components, this paper describes how to realize the functions of ride-sense open-loop control on large passenger aircraft, including how to put forward evaluation criteria, design requirements, implementation steps and physical installation implementation, etc., which has engineering practical value and provides realistic reference significance for the subsequent development of civil aircraft design.

articleTitle: Doppler echo construction method of wide-band moving target in sonar
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: Theoretical detection efficiency analysis and actual detection effectiveness evaluation of active sonar are closely related to the Doppler phenomenon of the target echo. The commonly used sonar echo construction method based on narrowband ambiguity function model only considers the frequency shift of the signal and ignores the broadening of the echo signal in time domain, resulting in large errors between the simulated signal and the actual signal. In this paper, a wideband Doppler echo construction method for moving targets is proposed. The Doppler phenomenon of HFM wideband signal is theoretically deduced and simulated from the frequency shift of the signal in the frequency domain to the compression in the time domain. The results show that this method can truly simulate the Doppler phenomenon of HFM wideband signal, which have strong reference value to analyze the theoretical detection efficiency of active sonar, the actual detection performance evaluation and waveform design.

articleTitle: Self-adapting Trajectory Planning Method Considering Joint Constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: When the robot interpolates the trajectory at high speed, the joint will exceed the constraint due to the constraints of driving mechanism performance and other factors. Based on the analysis of driver constraints, an adaptive trajectory planning method based on joint constraints is proposed. Firstly, maximum ranges of joint velocities in joint space are analyzed in advance by using the look-ahead strategy for speed control. Secondly, a maximum runnable resultant velocity in this path is calculated based on the linear relationship between joint velocity in joint space and path velocity in Cartesian space. Finally, the path velocity in Cartesian space is used for interpolation. The simulation and experimental results show that compared with the traditional method, the proposed Trajectory planning method can give full play to the driving performance of the robot joints while ensuring the real-time performance, taking into account the operating efficiency and constraint requirements of the robot.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent book sorting system based on PLC control
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: The project designs an intelligent book sorting system based on PLC and touch screen control, comprehensively applies PLC technology, RFID technology, touch screen technology, sensor technology, transmission technology and other automatic control technologies, develops and designs an intelligent book sorting system, effectively completes the sorting and classification of returned books in the library, and carries out, detection, transmission and sorting of books efficiently and accurately.

articleTitle: Persistent Surveillance Method of Multiple Mobile Robots Based on Pheromone Positive Incentive Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: This paper focuses on the persistent surveillance method of multiple mobile robots. Firstly, the existing calculation method of grid element value is improved by using pheromone. Then, aiming at two problems brought by the traditional persistent surveillance method: (1) when the initial positions of multiple robots are close to each other, they are easy to concentrate in a local area-this paper adjusts the weighting parameters ω<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>, good results are obtained; (2) sometimes, different robots are allocated to the same target point at the same time-this paper uses the method of allocating suboptimal target points and random allocation to improve this phenomenon, and compares the effects of suboptimal allocation and random allocation. The results show that suboptimal allocation is better than random allocation.

articleTitle: Study on temperature field of graphite machine considering temperature rise of linear motor
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: The influence of linear motor temperature rise on the precision of graphite machine spindle end is studied by experiment and simulation based on a certain type of graphite machine. Firstly, the surface temperature of linear motor is taken as the thermal boundary condition, and air medium is used for convection heat transmission. For observing the thermal deformation of the spindle end, the thermal simulation analyses of graphite machine are carried out by using ANSYS Workbench finite element software. Then the surface temperature of the linear motors is measured by using thermocouple, and the positioning accuracy of the graphite machine spindle end is measured by using laser interferometer. Finally, the thermal deformation of the spindle end is compared with the measurement results of the positioning accuracy error of spindle end. The analysis results show that the temperature rise of the linear motor has little influence on the accuracy of the spindle end. The research in this paper is helpful for the future research about the influence of linear motor temperature rise on the thermal deformation of a machine tool.

articleTitle: Research on Real Time Processing of Continuous Small Line Segments Based on Hermite Spline
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: CNC system to continuous small line segment directly linear interpolation processing, due to the velocity of discontinuous, the processing will show low efficiency and low surface quality. Usually, the small line segments are fitted into a curve, and curve interpolation is used to improve the processing quality. A real-time processing method of Hermite spline is proposed by studying the fitting and interpolation methods. Based on the global geometric information, the algorithm prejudges the trajectory of the CL-points of the part to be machined, and extracts the small line segments that meet the conditions for Hermite spline real-time fitting, so as to optimize the machining trajectory of the small line segments. And under the limited conditions such as tolerance, the Hermite spline is interpolated, so as to realize CNC milling of continuous small line segments of any contour. Finally, the algorithm is applied to the CNC system, and the machining experiment is carried out. The results show that the algorithm can optimize the machining trajectory, which is beneficial to improve the machining quality and machining stability.

articleTitle: Reseach on Rigid-flexible Coupling Dynamics Simulation of SCARA Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: With the rapid growth of SCARA robot market, the market competition becomes more and more fierce, and its design is facing greater challenges. In order to evaluate the rationality of SCARA robot design more accurately and quickly, the rigid-flexible coupling dynamic simulation analysis method of SCARA robot is established based on Adams and Nastran software. Firstly, the main structures of SCARA robot are flexiblized by using finite element software Nastran. The joints are flexible according to the characteristics of harmonic reducer. A rigid-flexible coupling dynamic model of SCARA robot is established in Adams. The dynamic strain results of the big arm and forearm under different operating conditions are obtained by simulation. Then the strain test of the big arm and forearm is carried out by using the resistance strain gauge to verify the accuracy of the simulation model. The results show that the calculated results are in good agreement with the experimental results, and the validity of the simulation analysis method is verified. Finally, based on the simulation model, the influence of structural stiffness and joint stiffness on the end displacement of SCARA robot is analyzed, which provides a theoretical basis for the design of SCARA robot.

articleTitle: Real-time monitoring method for vibration and deformation of curved thin-walled parts machining
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: A real-time online monitoring method of vibration and deformation of curved thin-walled parts machining is proposed for the problems of cutting point and curvature time variation, real-time movement and rotation of sensors during the machining of curved thin-walled parts. The PH isometric curve method is used to model the sensor trajectory, obtain the monitoring trajectory equation and rotation equation, and complete the hardware selection and system construction on this basis. The system provides an effective real-time online monitoring solution for vibration deformation of curved thin-walled parts.

articleTitle: Design of Remote Monitoring System for Ski Resorts Based on CPS
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: In recent years, ski resorts have gradually become the first choice for people to travel and vacation in winter. But the current monitoring system of ski resorts is not mature and perfect. Therefore, this paper proposes a remote real-time monitoring system for ski resorts based on the CPS (information physical system) three-layer (physical layer, cyber layer and decision layer) theoretical model, combined with the B/S (browser/server) mode of computer technology. The physical layer uses embedded devices and sensors to gather information about the ski resorts. In the network layer, a web cloud server is built based on the ASP.NET Core framework to complete the data transmission. The decision-making layer uses the front-end development language to build a web human-computer interaction page for data display. This system can realize remote real-time monitoring of the ski resort meteorological data (temperature and humidity, wind speed and direction) and image information, which is the intelligent information of the ski resort monitoring system. Transformation provides actionable solutions.

articleTitle: Data Encryption System for Smart Homes
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: With the improvement of people's living standards and the increasing maturity of wireless transmission technology, smart home is further promoted and applied, but due to the imperfect development of smart home bureau, there are still many security risks, mainly in the lack of effective authentication mechanism, the security of authentication is not high; smart home devices have loopholes, smart devices have memory loopholes, logic loopholes; data security is not high, in the transmission The data security is not high, and it is easy to be stolen and listened to during the transmission. In this paper, based on data security aspects, combining previous research experiences and combining asymmetric and symmetric encryption algorithms, we propose a smart home data encryption system based on RSA + AES hybrid encryption to improve the communication security of each smart home.

articleTitle: Multichannel asynchronous electrical stimulation device relieves muscle fatigue caused by stimulation therapy
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: Medical electronic devices using functional electrical stimulation can effectively treat hemiplegia patients who have lost muscle contraction function, but they are not widely used. The purpose of this study is to use low-frequency distributed asynchronous stimulation to alleviate muscle fatigue. We compared previous single-channel stimulation in the same tissue in space and frequency using multiple electrodes of the same muscle. On the whole, the synthetic stimulation effect of multi-channel ordered stimulation is consistent with that of single channel. Results: By comparing the fatigue parameters (muscle signal before and after stimulation, muscle contraction intensity, joint torque, etc.), multi-channel asynchronous stimulation reduced fatigue by 30% compared with single-channel stimulation. The problem of stimulation fatigue is further solved.

articleTitle: A Dual-Fan Aircraft Use l-sOAT for Pitch control: Modelling and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: In this paper, first an overview and explanation of the lateral single-axis Oblique Active Tilting (l-sOAT) control structure is presented. A complete dynamic model of vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) having longitudinal rotor tilting mechanism is developed using a Newton-Euler formulation for l-sOAT mechanism. Then, a theoretical analysis of l-sOAT vehicle control response and stability for pitch motion is described and simulated using the derived dynamic model. The validity of the proposed structure and its dynamic model is verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: A sound source positioning system based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: In the “post-epidemic era”, the requirement of online meeting grow rapidly and related technologies attracts a lot of attention. As an efficient method to improve the sound clarity and reduce noise, sound source positioning can strengthen the signal in the direction of sound source, while reduce the noise from other directions. In this work, a sound source position system based on FPGA was proposed, which was consisted of microphone matrix as signal input and FGPA as hardware platform to accelerate the localization algorithm. The microphone matrix was constructed by MEMS. On-chip system was built on Nexys Video, a FPGA development board carrying DDR3. The XADC of Artix-7 series FPGA was used to collect the electrical signals output by the microphone matrix and the obtained data was stored in DDR3. A sound source location algorithm acceleration module was designed in the FPGA and it acquired date from DDR3 via the stream transmission bus. Finally, the azimuth and angle of the sound source were outputted. Experiments demonstrated this system could achieve accurate date of the sound source by a commercial microphone matrix.

articleTitle: Optimization and Control of Process Parameters for Sawing Hard and Brittle Materials in Diamond Circular Saw Blade
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: To improve sawing ability, this paper proposes a decision method to evaluate the optimal combination of process parameters by means of the ratio <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$Q$</tex> of saw blade transverse vibration energy to material removal rate to minimize sawing vibration based on increasing material removal rate. Firstly, a three-factor, three-level sawing test was designed in this paper to obtain the material removal rate and saw blade transverse vibration response during sawing of hard and brittle rock. Secondly, the Taguchi method was used to optimize the ratio Q. The best combination of sawing process parameters was determined as follows: the sawing depth is 13 mm, the rotating speed is 180 rad/s, and the feeding speed is 10 mm/s. The effect of the parameters of circular sawblade on sawing performance was obtained as follows: rotating speed <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$>$</tex> feeding speed <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$>$</tex> sawing depth. The results show that the optimization decision method has high reliability and provides an effective way to determine the optimal combination of material removal rate and saw blade transverse vibration for the process parameters.

articleTitle: Decision Making Bot Algorithm in Real-Time Strategy Games
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: This paper discovers a cheap decision-making method by using data-mining techniques to find a sequence of relatively optimal sub-actions under a given truncated condition from the information of previous decision-making experts' complex actions under different conditions. This method can find a local-maximal solution without massive data and computation. Also, the provided conditions can be imperfect, which means data fragments and limited outliers are accepted. This paper then applied this method to implement a bot in StarCraft 2, a classical RTS game developed by Blizzard Entertainment.

articleTitle: A new hp-adaptive mesh refinement method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: For the optimal control problem, a grid refinement method based on adaptive hp is proposed, which is combined with symplectic pseudospectral method. The method takes the residuals of the discrete first-order necessary conditions at the sampling points as the accuracy estimation criterion of the solution. Whether the integral value of the curvature density curve exceeds the threshold is used to judge the smoothness of the stator interval. If it exceeds the threshold, it is determined as a sub interval that is not smooth enough. The mesh refinement method of cutting the region where the wave crest of the state variable curve is located is used. For sufficiently smooth sub intervals, a mesh refinement method of lifting interpolation order combined with the integral value of curvature density is used. Numerical simulation results show the rationality and effectiveness of the method. The method has high accuracy and computational efficiency.

articleTitle: A deep optimization Algorithm for calculation of the flight trajectory of the launch vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: With the development of modern technology and application requirements, the launch platforms of the launch vehicle are gradually diversified and the flight trajectories are gradually complicated. The traditional basic calculation algorithms cannot meet the fast calculation requirements of the flight trajectories. Based on the traditional flight trajectory integration method and the classical Newton iteration algorithm, the iterative calculation time and calculation accuracy are optimized respectively, the adaptive optimal algorithm and the adaptive deviation increment algorithm are derived, a deep optimization algorithm for the calculation of the flight trajectory of launch vehicle is proposed. The simulation calculation and verification results show that the deep optimization algorithm can increase the average iterative calculation time to 1/40, that is, improve the calculation speed of the flight trajectory. At the same time, it can ensure the same accuracy as the traditional algorithm.

articleTitle: Point Cloud Segmentation Algorithm on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: With the rapid development of 3d point cloud acquisition methods, point cloud segmentation has become increasingly important in computer vision, logistics robot and other fields. We proposes a point cloud segmentation method on convolutional neural network to realize semantic segmentation of indoor point cloud scenes, which has uneven density, complex object category, chaotic spatial direction and no pixel information. This method can extract local information, which mainly including nearest neighbor normal vector, curvature and Euclidean distance, global information supplemented by spatial height from all points in point cloud. The convolutional neural network is used to train the extracted information and to realize the classification of objects. The experimental performance and effectiveness has been verified by simulation and experiments, obtain 0.17 mAP@0.5 on ScannetV2.

articleTitle: Control Performance Analysis and Parameter Optimization of a Wave Compensation Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: To extend the time window of carrying out offshore installations e.g., maintenance of wind turbines, offshore structures, etc., a Stewart platform is utilized to serve as a wave compensation platform on a vessel, then, equipment on the platform will have the same precision with those fixed on the load. To implement wave compensation, a control method based on the velocity feedforward compensator is presented, and some further analysis are carried out, including, the effect of dynamic characteristics of the Stewart platform on wave compensation, the relation of system performance improvement due to the velocity feedforward compensator with dynamic characteristics, and optimizing geometry parameters to improve the dynamic characteristics. Finally, calculation results are given out for the above issues.

articleTitle: Prediction System of In-Run Speed in Skiing Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: The researchers designed an embedded system that can measure wind speed, wind direction, temperature and other environmental elements in real time and measure the in-run speed of athletes precisely. Information collection was completed by this system to build a BP neural network mode in which the environmental elements and in-run distance as iniput nodes and the in-run speed as the output node. The mode was established to predict the in-run speed and provide quantitative reference for coaches and athletes in training or competition.

articleTitle: Trajectory Planning and Attitude Control of Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: In this paper, the stability and smoothness of trajectory planning and attitude control of the manipulator are studied. The DH motion model of Kinova Jaco Gen-2 manipulator was established to solve the forward and inverse kinematics equations. Firstly, the third-order Bezier curve is designed to plan the trajectory of manipulator, which has good continuity and smoothness, and can control the workspace. Secondly, an attitude interpolation method based on quaternion is proposed. And different attitude interpolation methods are compared and analyzed, and spherical linear interpolation method is used to solve the problem of uneven velocity of the linear interpolation method. Finally, MATLAB robot toolbox is used to simulate and verify that the angle of each joint changes smoothly, and the trajectory of manipulator has good smoothness and stability based on Bezier curve and quaternion interpolation. According to the experimental results, the path planning based on the third order Bezier curve and spherical linear interpolation has a continuous smooth joint trajectory curve and a continuous joint angular velocity curve. The manipulator can move smoothly to the target point under the constraint of the end posture. Therefore, the trajectory planning method can be used as an ideal planning method for manipulator.

articleTitle: Piano Beginner: A Glove-based Finger Training VR Application
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: It has been studied that playing piano can improve people's cognitive ability and intelligence level even delay the progress of brain aging because of complex and regular finger movements. In nowadays, more and more attention has been paid to finger training in children's intellectual development. In this research, we develop a virtual-reality (VR) application-Piano Beginner, which is a finger training system with auditory and visual feedback (AVFB), using data gloves. The results show independent movement recognition of each single finger and then playing music “Happy New year” with multi-fingers.

articleTitle: Research on BP Neural Network Normalization Algorithm Based on Snow Friction Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: The 2022 Winter Olympics will be held in Beijing, and skiing is one of the sports. Athletes want to achieve excellent results, in addition to their own ability, they will also be affected by temperature, humidity, wind speed, wind direction, snow friction coefficient, snow angle and so on. In this paper, a set of snow field environment measurement device and BP neural network normalization algorithm based on snow surface friction coefficient are designed. The device is equipped with temperature and humidity sensor, wind speed and direction sensor, inclination sensor, tension sensor and IMU sensor to measure the environmental parameters of snow field. The tester uses this device to measure the environmental parameters of the snow field in the snow field and display them on the QT interface in real time, so as to provide effective scientific reference for coaches and athletes and improve the competitive performance of athletes.

articleTitle: Analysis of cutting vibration of aluminum alloy 6061 thin-walled parts
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: Based on the milling experiment of thin-walled parts, this paper explores the influence of the spindle speed, one of the machining parameters, on the vibration of the workpiece. The LMS signature device was placed in the cutting direction of the flat thin-walled parts to collect the data changes of workpiece vibration during milling; the cutting vibration of flat thin-walled parts with different heights and thicknesses was studied under the condition of changes in spindle speed. The cutting vibration of flat thin-walled parts is discussed. The following conclusions are drawn: when the height of the thin-walled part and the rotational speed of the spindle are the same, the thickness of the thin-walled part increases, and the vibration amplitude of the workpiece decreases; As the height increases, the vibration of the acceleration amplitude gradually decreases; when the thickness and height of the thin-walled parts are the same, and the spindle speed is different, the change of the acceleration amplitude is a constant trend of first decreasing and then increasing.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of New Type Spinning Equipment End Actuator
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern advanced manufacturing technology, spinning forming technology has become one of the optimal processing methods for thin-walled rotary parts. In this paper, based on the motion principle of the oscillating guide rod mechanism, a new spin forming method for non-circular section thin-walled parts is proposed. According to the theory and method of reliability analysis, the response surface method is used to fit the limit of the end actuator of the spinning forming device. State equation, solve the reliability of the end actuator, calculate the reliability sensitivity of each input variable, quantitatively analyze the influence of the relevant parameters of the key components of the end actuator on the reliability of the mechanism and compare.

articleTitle: Multi-model decision-making seizure types classification based on transfer learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: For brain doctors, knowing the type of seizures in patients with epilepsy is conducive to accurate treatment of patients. Although many researchers have done enough research on the prediction and detection of epileptic seizures, there is a lack of research on the classification of seizure types. Therefore, in order to classify the 8 types of epileptic seizures, this article proposes two ideas based on the fusion of multi-models of transfer learning. Extract the MAS features from the 22 montage combined channels, use reliefF for feature selection, and finally convert it to images. Use the following two transfer learning strategies:(1) Transfer learning multi-model feature fusion, (2) Transfer learning multi-model classification probability fusion. On the TUSZ data set of temple university school of medicine, use six pre-trained models of Alexnet, Googlenet, Inception-v3, Resnet18, Vgg16, and Vgg19. The results show that the proposed algorithm are better than the compared algorithms. The probability fusion strategy is adopted to obtain the best classification performance, classification accuracy and F1 score reaching 98.48% and 97.61 %, respectively.

articleTitle: Mobile Robot Path Planning in 2D space: A survey
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: For decades, the path planning method has evolved at a fast speed ever and in a great amount. This paper briefly summarizes the existing path planning algorithm of mobile robots in a 2D plane. We classify path planning algorithms into four categories, namely classical methods, bionic methods, artificial intelligence methods, and hybrids methods, and introduce representative algorithms of each category respectively. A thorough review and classification of existing path planning algorithms are provided, which is beneficial for beginners in mobile robotics research. We demonstrate principal ideas for each type of path planning algorithm and provide discussions of the feasibility of real-world application for practitioners.

articleTitle: Rock fracture detection and lithology classification in field outcrop area based on the architecture of RC-SegNet
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: In the geological survey, the rock fracture and rock types in the field outcrop areas can provide critical information for the study of oil and gas transportation in the formation. This information is typically extracted by manual annotation, which is time-consuming, inefficient, and inaccurate. A rock crack segmentation encoder-decoder structural model, namely, RC-SegNet, which is based on deep learning is proposed to segment the crack and rock types simultaneously. A dataset of 2925 rock images are prepared to train and to verify the proposed model, the results demonstrate that the proposed model achieves the best overall accuracy of 91.4% compared to the other models on the task of rock fracture and rock types segmentation.

articleTitle: Voronoi-Based Collision Avoidance Using Localization Uncertainty Region
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: Multi-robot systems have been applied to numerous professional areas in industry, consisting of applications from warehousing logistics to drone swarm for military. Under realistic working conditions, errors of localizations may lead to collisions between robots although the multi-robot system is theoretically collision-free. This paper introduces a comprehensive control algorithm for collision-free multi-robot systems based on buffered Voronoi diagram enhanced by localization uncertainty region. Compared to previous related works, this paper combines the features of the Voronoi diagram, two-dimensional Gaussian distribution and the deadlock avoidance algorithm together to derive a control algorithm endowing the multi-robot system with high robustness and practical reliability.

articleTitle: A review of the development status of exoskeleton robots for lower extremity rehabilitation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: With the progress of our society and the desire of lower extremity disabled patients to restore their own lower extremity capabilities, lower extremity rehabilitation exoskeleton robots have become a research hotspot in various countries. According to the literature survey, this paper summarizes the research status of the main research institutions at home and abroad on the lower limb rehabilitation exoskeleton walking robot, analyzes the key technologies that need to be solved in the development of the lower limb rehabilitation exoskeleton robot, and points out the future domestic research and development of the lower limb rehabilitation exoskeleton robot In terms of structural modularity and intelligent control system, a sound rehabilitation effect evaluation system should be established in terms of rehabilitation effect monitoring.

articleTitle: Target Tracking Based on Kalman Filtering Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: Target tracking techniques aim at estimating desired target states online overtime. This paper introduces and derives algorithms for both single and multiple targets tracking, most of which are based on Kalman filtering technique. We demonstrate that multiple target tracking is more complicated that single target tracking in that data association techniques are required to match estimate target tracks with true targets. We present simulation examples of applications of both single and multiple target tracking in MAT LAB to demonstrate and analysis the performance of our introduced algorithms. In both tests, moving targets are successfully tracked via RGB camera with object recognition algorithms to extract the target features.

articleTitle: Research on Modal Calculation of Six Joint Industrial Robot at Different Poses
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: In order to study the influence of different poses on the structural modes of a six joint industrial robot, a calculation method based on the theory of substructure and DOF reduction is proposed. Firstly, the DOF of the joint arm is reduced by using the FE software. Secondly, the stiffness matrix containing 3-dimension torsion stiffness of the reducers is established to consider the joint flexibility, and the equivalent generalized mass matrix is established to consider the inertia of the robot's accessories. Combined with the kinematics of the robot, the direct calculation of modal frequency and modal shape of the robot under different poses is realized by programming. The error of the first 6-order modal frequencies calculated by this method is less than 4% by comparing with the modal test results of the robot. The calculated results indicate that the first two-order modal frequencies of the robot vary about 47.2% and 76.7% under different poses in the workspace, which are mainly affected by the joint angles of J2 and J3.

articleTitle: Multi-robot Object Finding Using Thompson Sampling
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: A typical job for multi-robot systems is distributed search, which has applications ranging from environmental monitoring to disaster response. In this paper, inspired by [19], we present a unique distributed control technique that uses Thompson sampling to enable robots to actively search for targets more quickly and effectively as robots are able to learn approximate target distribution online and trade-off between hanging around areas with higher possibility to find targets and explore these with lower possibility. We validate the presented methods by a series of simulation tests.

articleTitle: Sampling-based Distributed Multi-target Search Using A Team of Mobile Robots
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Control Engineering and Robotics (ISCER)
abstract: This paper introduces a distributed algorithm for a team of robots to search for an unknown number of static or dynamic targets in a known environment. Compared with single robots, multi-robot systems are promising for higher efficiency and convergence rate in completing such tasks. Our method models the active search task as a multi-armed bandit problem and solves it via Thompson sampling to allow robots to balance between exploiting the areas with high target distribution density for instant rewards and exploring the areas with low target distribution density for any potential target appearance. A series of simulation experiments show that our introduced algorithm can be successfully applied to multi-robot target search with high efficiency.
